notes.title: Patch Notes for June 24, 2025 (macOS)
notes.content:
The following updates were made to the macOS version of the game:

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue causing clicks not to register on some devices.
[*] Fixed various issues related to launching the game on a device with multiple monitors.
[*] Fixed some issues with the game rendering full screen on some devices.
[*] Fixed an issue causing users unable to use the Space Bar when naming things.
[*] Fixed missing hover tooltips.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for 4/5/2025
notes.content:
This version addresses highly requested fan feedback and improvements!

New players should see the initial size of the UI display at a larger size, making it easier to see on higher resolution displays.

Control UI scaling with convenient hotkeys:
    - SHIFT + U: increase UI
    - CONTROL + U: Decrease UI

Please send any support requests to support@atari.com. Thanks for playing!

notes.title: macOS Update - Patch Notes for 4/3/2025
notes.content:
Thanks for bearing with us while we update the greatest roller coaster sim of all time! 

We're excited to share that this version works with the latest versions of macOS!

Having trouble? Please send any support requests to support@atari.com. Including details about your OS version will help us improve the experience more quickly!

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Update Jan 21
notes.content:
v2.12.110 - various fixes and additions thoughout, the main ones being:

- Dutch language added.
- Zoom mini view disabled during ride re-paint.
- Various fixes to mouse cursor icons.
- Hover help improvements.
- Auto repeat added to name entry.

PC

- Improved Toolkit Import functionality.

Mac

- Missing punctuation added to keyboard name entry.
- Fix for stretched drop-down menus.
- Fix for alignment on guest list.
